about: Round pockets that receive a bought part. Each kind names the fit parameters its size comes from: "d" the pocket diameter, "depth" the pocket depth, "part_h" the height of the bought part. A blind hole whose deepest diameter is the value of "d" (within tol.d) and that is not deeper than depth_max_factor times "depth" is a pocket of that kind. fits.bought_part_pocket judges the tags of "d" and "depth"; print.z_layers judges the depth against "part_h" in whole layers. A new bought part with a round pocket is one more kind here and its parameters in the registry; both rules list those parameters in "params". Several rows may receive the same kind of part in other sizes (magnet, magnet_d6). "pins": a hole with a steel pin, dowel or rod on its axis (its own name matches the parameter "pattern") is a pocket of that pin; "fits" names the parameter of each fit, the hole diameter over the pin diameter (rules/tables/pins.json holds the pins and their stock lengths). "boxes": slots and windows of the census (openings) that receive a bought part that is not round; "w" and "l" name the parameters of its two sizes (l null: matched by its width alone, a nut slid in from the side), within tol.box. Every parameter a row names is of class fit, and every rule that reads the table lists it.

pins.receives: a steel pin, dowel or rod

plug_channel.receives: a motor plug on its way through

nut_slot_m3.receives: an M3 nut slid in from the side
